summary.text: Chuck Schumer was elected to the U.S. Senate from New York in 1998 and became the state's senior senator when Daniel Patrick Moynihan retired in 2000.

paragraphs.text: He was elected to the New York State Assembly after graduating from Harvard Law School in 1974, and in 1980 was elected to the U.S. House, representing a Brooklyn and Queens district for eighteen years.
He was born and raised in Brooklyn, graduated from James Madison High School and Harvard University, and still lives in Brooklyn.
